name: BDD: Phone Verification page
summary:
User Story: GWA-6628, GWA-21686

Tier(/s): Office/Phoenix/Fax

Brand: UK/EU/US/CA/AU/Charter

Account type(/s): Admin
preconditions:
Entry point(/s): 
  1. Pass signup and get activation e-mail.
  2. Set cookie gw_autotest_skip_smb = 1 before opening activation link
  3. Remember "Contact number" which was used as Contact Number on Signup
  4. To emulate the situation when phone verification is needed set cookie confirm_result - NotConfirmed_RequiresPhoneVerification on domain/web/setup/qa.html page (Use the correct domain for your environment) 

Note:

  • For brands which possible to change language use en_us locale to check strings in this case.

steps.name: Open activation link in the same browser wher you set cookie
steps.expectedResult: You are redirected to phone verification page

steps.name: Observe page
steps.expectedResult:
1. Logo is displayed related to brand.
  2. Title: "Mobile Number Verification".
  3. Text: "Use for authentication of your mobile phone number"
  4. Text: "By clicking Next, you will be receiving a phone call in a few seconds that will provide you with a verification code that you must enter in the following screen."

steps.name: Check the appearing of saved "Contact number" in "Mobile Number" field
steps.expectedResult: The number should be the same as "Contact number"

steps.name: Leave "Mobile Number" input field empty and click "Next" button
Enter correct number and click "Next" button. Check the block
steps.expectedResult:
1. "Verification code" field appears 
  2. "Mobile Number field becomes not editable
  3. "Edit" button appears
  4. "Did not receive the call? Try again!" link appears

steps.name: Click on "Did not receive the call? Try again!"
steps.expectedResult: Text: "Your verification code has been resent to your contact phone number." appears

steps.name: Click on the "Edit" button.
steps.expectedResult:
• "Verification code" field disappeared
  • "Mobile Number" field becomes editable
  • "Edit" button disappeared

steps.name: Enter the wrong number and click "Next"
steps.expectedResult: An error message "The contact phone number you entered appears to be invalid, please check the number and try again" appears above the field.

steps.name: Enter correct phone number and incorrect verification code and press "Next"
steps.expectedResult: An error message "Verification code is not valid" appear
